newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soluble industry can import coffee-minister.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soluble industry can import coffee-minister.

text.p: The Brazilian soluble industry can import coffee if it wants, Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles said Thursday.
"The industry is able to import. If it wants to, it can," Dornelles told reporters.

Brazil's soluble industry has been pressing the government to release stocks to it so it can meet production demand. It has put off a project to import coffee while the government studies the stock-lending proposal.

But the proposal to lend stocks to the soluble industry, recently trumpeted as a done deal, has apparently come unstuck as the Ministry of Industry and Commerce and the Finance Ministry battle over it.

Earlier Thursday, a Finance Ministry official said the ministry was still studying the plan and that it was possible it might call meetings next week with officials from the Ministry of Industry and Commerce.
